sentences.answer: Buying and selling commodities with other countries is called trade.
Countries trade because they produce different goods.
International specialization means countries produce the things they are good at.
After the war, Japan imported raw materials and exported manufactured goods.
A trade surplus means exports are higher than imports.
Many companies moved their factories to developing countries.
The number of factories in Japan decreased.
Deindustrialization means factories move to other countries.
Consumers pay consumption tax to retailers and producers.
Consumption tax is an indirect tax.
People with low incomes pay a higher proportion of their income in consumption tax.
A regressive tax means people with low incomes pay a higher proportion of their income.
People with high incomes pay a higher proportion of their income in income tax.
A progressive tax means people with high incomes pay a higher proportion of their income.
Governments combine different kinds of taxes to make taxes fair.
People with the same income should pay the same amount of tax.
